rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, 2006).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2006 as 'Red Hot'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Small, single (4-8 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped-to-flat bloom form.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or garden.
